checks.command: cargo test --locked --manifest-path truelearner/Cargo.toml -p truelearner-core --test runtime_attachment && cargo test --locked --manifest-path truelearner/Cargo.toml -p truelearner-embodiment --test runtime_attachment

findings: The missing transition is implemented as opt-in discovery physics: an actual returned transition closes and credits exactly one live participating action path before that return can request another action.
The identity and ambiguity controls pass. Samples, unrelated transition origins, and multiple matching paths receive no consequence; only the unique physical pullback is consumed.

The predicted coarse-graining passes. Two exact closures construct exactly one existing learner, and an unrelated runtime attachment before versus after the active component does not change outward history or learner extent.

The unknown two-sided regulation capability is falsified, not inferred from the lower success. The positive branch closes once and stalls at position 2; the negative branch makes the same unresolved initial choice, reaches -4, crosses no retained transition surface, and records no consequence.

All 158 non-ignored core and embodiment tests pass; eight frozen adversarial or negative probes remain ignored. The representative warm regression completes in 0.09 seconds, below the strict ten-second limit.
residual_uncertainty: This supports exact attachment-natural cycle closure and existing learner coarse-graining as development mechanisms. It does not support autonomous regulation, collective competence, morphology transfer, vision-guided reaching, or keyboard use.

The first missing physical map is now at the containing-body scale: after a child cycle closes, a body-owned local constraint must remain active while the larger disturbance is unresolved and become identity when quiet. Putting that state in the sensor would violate the tested factorization.

The negative branch also shows that sparse transition surfaces can omit a worsening physical change. The next arm must expose continuing body disturbance without supplying direction, scalar position, a correct output, or an evaluator center.

The candidate remains opt-in on a dirty development worktree and does not alter accepted or default protocol authority. The receipt digest covers unrelated pre-existing changes, which were preserved but not attributed to this candidate.
